intro.h2: Bathrooms and Home Repairs Without the Upsell
paragraphs: ARM Home Care offers bathroom remodeling in Morristown, from a full powder room update to fixing a glass shower door that will not close. Call (973) 348-9915 and Tom sends the right people for the job.

What reviewers notice is honesty about scope. One homeowner said Don suggested a minimally invasive fix, which made her confident nobody was trying to up-sell her, and the crew cleaned the bathroom afterward. Others say Tom answers his calls, tracks down parts when a job needs them, and keeps quotes competitive. Several people hired ARM Home Care once and then called back for the next project.

items.name: Bathroom and powder room remodels
items.blurb: ARM Home Care's Facebook page invites homeowners to remodel their powder room and call for an estimate, and Google lists the company as a bathroom remodeler. Talk with Tom about layout, fixtures and flooring, and get a quote before you decide.

items.name: Glass shower door repair
items.blurb: When a glass shower door stops closing properly, you want someone used to working with glass. For one homeowner, Don recommended a minimally invasive repair, finished it efficiently and cleaned up the bathroom afterward. Smaller fixes like this are part of the work.

items.name: Flooring and finished basements
items.blurb: Flooring is one of the services ARM Home Care lists, and their Google photos include a finished basement with wood-look plank floors, white trim, double closet doors and an open-tread staircase. Ask about flooring for baths, kitchens or lower levels.

image.alt: Finished basement with wood-look plank flooring, recessed lights, white double closet doors and open-tread stairs

items.name: Built-ins and carpentry
items.blurb: Their project photos include a full wall of painted built-in bookshelves framing a French door, trimmed up to the crown molding. If you want storage or finish carpentry done along with a bathroom project, mention it when you call.

image.alt: White painted built-in bookshelves floor to ceiling around a glass-paned French door

items.name: Attic stairs and water damage repair
items.blurb: Facebook posts offer attic stair installs and replacements, plus repair of water-damaged wood framing and windows down to the foundation sill plates, sealed against future water damage. Call if you have found soft wood or leaks around a window.

about.h2: About Tom and the ARM Home Care Crew
about.text: ARM Home Care, LLC is a bathroom remodeling and home care company based in Morristown, New Jersey. Tom is the person customers call: reviewers say he answers the phone, sends the right crew and tracks down parts when a job needs one. Don and Carlos are the names that come up on site. The work runs from powder room remodels and flooring to glass shower door repairs, attic stairs and water damage repair. Many customers hire them for one job and keep calling back for the next.

testimonials.h2: What Customers Say About ARM Home Care

items.name: Risa
items.text:
I recently had an issue with our glass shower door not closing properly, and I needed a handyman service that was experienced with glass materials. I reached out to ARM Home Care, and Tom sent Don and his partner.
Don recommended a solution that was minimally invasive which made me feel confident he wasn't trying to  up-sell me. Don and his partner completed the repair efficiently and even took the time to clean up my bathroom afterward, which I really appreciated.
I've already called ARM Home Care back for additional projects.I highly recommend Tom and his team for anyone needing reliable and expert home care services!

items.name: MJ Y.
items.text: I have experience seeking professionals for minor home projects and other major projects including  additions. One of the most heightened stresses of this process is finding a trust worthy contractor. Tom and his colleagues Don and Carlos made my recent projects easy. They are very simple to work with and very transparent. I will keep them on speed dial for future work! Do not hesitate to work with them, at least get a quote. They are very competitive and super nice. Thanks for a great experience this far!

items.name: Glen V.
items.text: I have hired Tom many times  for all kinds of projects around my home. Tom is excellent  at answering calls. If he has to track down a part for the job he certainly will. True professional.  That does excellent work.  I highly recommend giving ARM Home Care a call for your next home project!

service_area.text: ARM Home Care is based in Morristown, New Jersey 07960, as listed in its own Facebook posts. Google does not publish an address or a service area for the company, so call (973) 348-9915 to check whether your town is covered. The work happens in customers' homes, from bathrooms, powder rooms and floors to attic stairs, built-in shelves and water-damaged framing.

items.a: ARM Home Care is open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday, according to Google. Call (973) 348-9915 during those hours, or email tom@armhomecare.com, to describe the project and set up a time to talk it through.

Yes. Reviews mention a glass shower door that would not close, parts tracked down for repairs, and all kinds of projects around one customer's home. Facebook posts also cover attic stairs and water damage repair, and bigger bathroom and powder room remodels are part of the work too.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: The company's Facebook post asks homeowners to call 973-348-9915 for an estimate on a powder room remodel, and one reviewer tells others to at least get a quote. Whether estimates are free is not published, so ask about that when you call.

Facebook posts list ARM Home Care in Morristown, New Jersey 07960. Google shows no street address or service area, because the work is done at customers' homes. Call to confirm your town is within reach before you book a visit.

Licence and insurance details are not published on Google or Facebook. New Jersey homeowners can ask for the company's Home Improvement Contractor registration number when they call, and it is worth asking for proof of insurance at the same time.
